mentions.name: Verso
mentions.description: Verso is a hobby-built 6 degree-of-freedom robotic arm using Dynamixel servos and a Raspberry Pi, with Python for the arm and JavaScript for the controller. The code is open source on GitHub.
mentions.source_excerpt:
As a hobby started working on Verso, a 6 DoF arm using Dynamixel servos, Raspberry Pi, python and javascript (for controller).
https://youtube.com/shorts/Wpnihkz23BE?feature=share

All code opensource at https://github.com/meekaaku/verso
